title: Cabinet Hardware Cabinet Pull 3-Inch Solid Brass Traditional Style | Shaded Beige | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom cabinetry with cabinet hardware crafted from solid brass, designed to bring a distinctive finishing touch to doors and drawers in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes.

  • Shaded Beige transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Cabinet-mount installation with all mounting hardware included
  • Coordinates easily within a cabinet hardware collection and other versatile bath accessories
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs

  • Type: Cabinet pull
  • Material: Brass
  • Style: Traditional
  • Mounting type: Cabinet mount
  • Dimensions: 3.9-inch L x 1.6-inch H x 0.9-inch W
  • Projection: 1-inch
  • Weight: 0.8 lb
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Cabinet pull and all installation hardware
